description: Three neighbours hold a red thread between balconies above a snail crossing a small red bridge over a puddle at dusk.
Two people in yellow raincoats stand beneath a huge curling glass-like green wave containing silver fish.
Five friends dine beneath a tree while their shadows form another dining group on the trunk, with one shadow raising a cup.
Stone stairs become folded blue blankets as they descend into clouds, with a red slipper on a foreground step.
A woman in a wheelchair holds out her hand beside a glowing purple flower containing silhouettes of an orchestra.
Two children pour water into a cracked clay riverbed, where the streams surround a long turquoise fish.
A woman holds a telephone receiver beside a wheat-filled phone booth, with a wheat stalk growing from the cord.
Three hikers hold ribbons flowing from a waterfall above a sleeping deer on a sunny mountainside.
A cleaner sweeps red leaves beneath a forest painting whose branches extend into the museum gallery.
Four adults push around a giant balance scale in a snowy square, with a white feather and a tiny lit house on its pans.
A woman opens a jewellery box containing a stormy sea and a small boat, with water and pearls spilling onto the table.
Two neighbours exchange a cactus between angular red-brick apartment balconies viewed from far below.
A brown horse with a blue flame-like mane crosses a pale salt flat, leaving a trail of grass-filled hoofprints.
Two potters shape a crescent-shaped clay bowl with a small willow tree growing in its centre.
Three adults with umbrellas approach the basket of a sock-covered balloon resting in a wet park beside a sleeping dog.
A small explorer touches amber containing a giant moth whose wings show fields, trees and a river.
Two older women push a giant watermelon slice along a white village street as its black seeds become flying birds.
A child holds a net containing dark rain clouds beside an older man with a glass jar, while a cloud rains onto a mushroom.
A swan stands on a raised theatre stage floor, exposing tree roots and a glowing blue pool beneath.
A baker opens a round loaf containing a sunlit desert and tiny travellers, with crumbs scattered on the counter.
A red tram hangs between cliffs in tree roots while an older person waits on a bench nearby.
People place candles on a frozen pond above an upside-down table and chairs visible beneath the ice.
A badger stands on a giant red bowl catching falling stars, while a wooden spoon casts a branching tree-shaped shadow.
Travellers look upward as their colourful scarves become birds in a railway station, while a child holds an open birdcage.
